title: targeted proof-only code_verified to pass sweep

scope.intent: Targeted proof-only sweep for safe code_verified rows where existing local tests directly satisfy the row requirement.
scope.product_changes: No product implementation, source code, test code, migration, schema, RPC, package, lockfile, Supabase, external-provider, or production data changes were made.
scope.runtime_boundary: Rows requiring browser/runtime mutation, external provider dashboards, live Sentry payloads, restore/rollback infrastructure, WhatsApp callback proof, production service-worker update proof, throttled mobile runtime proof, DB/RPC/schema work, or production-only access were left open.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Single warp and single weft recipe: yarn kg, yarn cost, weave cost, processing, overhead, landed cost, and quote match truth sheet.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/estimator.test.ts imports calcFullTotals and calcOrderQuote and asserts representative single warp/weft costing fixtures including yarn kg/cost, weave cost, overhead, total production cost, landed cost, quote price, and gross profit.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Pure local deterministic estimator math proof; no DB, provider, browser, Supabase, package install, migration, or production mutation.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Width entered in centimeters and equivalent inches: equivalent calculation and persisted value.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/width-field.test.ts covers cm/inch conversion, equivalent costing parity, localStorage width-unit persistence, and warning behavior.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Safe local proof, but self-review found it does not directly prove quote/runtime persistence of the width value, so it is not pass-ready in Batch 13.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Weaving rate entered in paise/pick: no rupee/paise 100x error.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/estimator.test.ts covers direct wage-to-rate conversion, paise direct entry, safe weave cost, and the old dangerous 100x failure mode.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Pure local deterministic estimator conversion/math proof.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Commission plus margin at or above invalid boundary: invalid quote state; no misleading positive quote.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/estimator.test.ts asserts calcOrderQuote returns isValid=false, a clear error message, and zero quote price when commission plus margin reaches the invalid boundary.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Pure local deterministic estimator function proof.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Complete market-run onboarding: Market Runs visible; Quotes/Orders hidden; core shared modules visible.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/production-mode.test.ts imports getWorkflowVisibility and asserts market-run workflow visibility.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Safe local helper proof, but self-review found it does not directly prove completed-onboarding/browser navigation persistence, so it is not pass-ready in Batch 13.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Complete order-based onboarding: Quotes/Orders visible; Market Runs hidden.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/production-mode.test.ts imports getWorkflowVisibility and asserts order-based workflow visibility.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Safe local helper proof, but self-review found it does not directly prove completed-onboarding/browser navigation persistence, so it is not pass-ready in Batch 13.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Base versus Premium access gates: correct modules gated; Billing itself remains reachable.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/p1-billing-gates.test.ts statically checks route layouts and billing reachability.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Supporting source evidence exists, but exact row wording still needs direct tier-behavior or browser comparison proof for base versus premium.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Settle in reminder window/on pay date/overdue: allowed with correct status.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: __tests__/payroll-cycle.test.ts covers scheduled, approaching, due_today, and overdue payroll window statuses.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Helper status coverage is partial; row also depends on settlement action/UI allow behavior.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Month-end/year-end: commercial collection and payroll cycles classify correctly.
candidate_rows_inspected.existing_evidence: Payroll/date helper tests and source-mirror evidence exist.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Exact commercial plus runtime/browser classification proof remains partial.

candidate_rows_inspected.row_requirement: Leap day: valid date and cycle behavior.
candidate_rows_inspected.reason: Exact browser/date-input proof remains partial, and the existing payroll-cycle test file does not directly assert the leap-day case.
